sentences.en: Last month I noticed that we were using a lot more water at home than before.
I had a look around, and only then did I find that the bathroom tap had not been turned off properly.
I turned it off right away, and from that day on I began to pay attention to how we use water.
These days my showers are shorter than they used to be, and when I brush my teeth I always turn the tap off.
The water left over from washing clothes I use to clean the room, so nothing at all is wasted.
My neighbour, an older lady, told me that the place where she grew up often had no water, so she is extremely careful with it.
She said: "Water looks cheap, but it is actually extremely important."
One person alone does not save much water, but if everyone did this, the world would be a different place.

quiz.q: How did the narrator first notice there was a problem?
a: The family was using a lot more water than before

quiz.q: What was wrong in the bathroom?
a: The tap had not been turned off properly

quiz.q: What does the neighbour say about water?
a: It should be bought in bottles
It looks cheap but is actually extremely important

grammar.p: A 比 B + adjective + 了很多 — much more than
grammar.e: 比 compares two things. Putting 了很多 (or 多了) after the adjective shows the gap is big; never add 很 before the adjective in a 比 sentence.
grammar.x: 家里用的水比以前多了很多。 — We were using a lot more water at home than before.

grammar.p: 把 + object + verb + 上 — 把 with a result complement
grammar.e: 把 puts the object before the verb when the action changes or disposes of it. Here 上 is a result complement meaning 'shut / closed'.
grammar.x: 刷牙的时候也一定把水关上。 — When you brush your teeth, always turn the tap off.

grammar.e: 如果 opens the condition. 就 belongs to the second clause and stands after its subject, right before the verb.
grammar.x: 如果每个人都这样做，世界就会不一样。 — If everyone did this, the world would be different.
